summary: Re-verified the full FEAT-1 code object (App.jsx, navigation.js, currentUser.js, useCurrentUser.js, AppShell/Sidebar/TopBar/UserBadge, masterDataApi.js, MasterDataView) directly against the SDD (round 2) and system-engineer's finalized design. No architecture restructuring was required: separation of concerns already holds cleanly at every seam this stage is responsible for.

verification.sdd_conformance: App.jsx retains the single outermost ternary on APP_SHELL_HASHES; AppShell never co-mounts with Header/Footer (AC-1 still holds).
coupling_checked: navigation.js (top-level NAV_ITEMS/APP_SHELL_HASHES route registry) vs masterDataApi.js (MASTER_DATA_TABLES sub-tab registry, internal to MasterDataView) — no authority overlap; navigation.js only references MasterDataView as an opaque component, never reaches into its internal table config. This is a clean two-level registry split (app-shell routes vs. a view's own internal tabs), not duplication.
TopBar -> UserBadge: TopBar carries no `user` prop; UserBadge is the sole useCurrentUser() call site (AC-5 still holds, no dead prop, no double-fetch reintroduced).
currentUser.js placement at src/lib/currentUser.js matches tech-lead's hard-constraint path and the existing masterDataApi.js/useMasterDataTable.js file-plus-hook idiom (AC-6 still holds).
AppShell composes Sidebar/TopBar by props only (items/activeId/onSelect, title) — no prop-drilling beyond one level, no context needed at this scale.
useCurrentUser is the single indirection seam between UI and the mock identity source; no component reaches into src/lib/currentUser.js directly.
verification.no_changes_needed_because: Every coupling/SoC concern raised earlier in the pipeline (architecture-critic AC-1/AC-5/AC-6, tech-lead's four scaling risks) was already resolved by engineer-mvp/system-engineer and reconfirmed by senior-engineer's stage 4.5 audit. Restructuring code that already matches its design and has no avoidable coupling would violate CLAUDE.md §1 (Minimal Impact / Simplicity First) for no benefit.
verification.build: npm run build — 58 modules, succeeds, no errors
verification.lint: npx oxlint src — only the one pre-existing, unrelated set-state-in-effect warning in untouched src/hooks/useMasterDataTable.js
